summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine has announced that Ukrainian forces struck four Russian drone command and control posts within a single 24-hour window across occupied Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Donetsk, and Russia’s Bryansk region. High-value targets included an elite “Rubikon” drone unit base in occupied Berdiansk, alongside posts near Oleshky, Bilytske, and Aleksandrovskoye.

title: Russia Suffers Record 16,130 Weekly Casualties, General Staff Says
titleRu: По данным Генерального штаба, Россия терпит рекордные 16 130 потерь в неделю
summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine has announced that Russian invading forces suffered a record 16,130 casualties between Nov. 1 and Nov. 7, marking the highest weekly loss rate since the start of the full-scale invasion in February 2022. The attrition rate averaged over 2,300 soldiers daily – the equivalent of an entire motorized rifle regiment neutralized every 24 hours, or nearly 100 troops per hour.
